definitions.CLIMAX: Selling climax (sellingClimaxScan): after a markdown (the low sits 10% under the 60-session high, 8.5% under the 20-session high or 14% under the 126-session high), a bar at the 20 / 60 / 126-session low that sold off or undercut, on climactic effort (volume and range well above the 60 sessions before the last 20) and with demand showing (a close in the upper part of the bar, or a rally of 2.5-3.5% inside 8 sessions). Listed while it is live: inside the last 40 sessions, score 4 or more, no confirmed low after it.
definitions.BOTTOM: Confirmed cycle low (structureScan): a swing low (15 sessions to the left, 10 to the right) at the 126- or 252-session low, at least 12% under the 252-session high, followed by a bounce of 4% or more inside 12 sessions; one low per 100-session cluster. It can only be read 40 sessions after the low. Listed while the low is inside the last 126 sessions.
definitions.ACCUM: End of accumulation (structureScan EOA): 8 to 50 sessions after a confirmed low, the first up-close bar that makes the highest high since the low and closes within 0.2% of that high and at least 6% above the low. Listed while the bar is inside the last 63 sessions.
definitions.DIST: Distribution (distributionScan): a swing high within 3% of the 189-session high after an advance of 15% off the 252-session low (or 30% off the 504-session low), where the latest push bought less than the push before it (more volume for less progress, or a new high by under 2.5%), price then gave back half of the push and 3.5% from the high inside 18 sessions, did not close back at the high in the next 6, and the reaction was worse than the one before. The mark prints on the bar that completes those tests. Listed while that bar is inside the last 63 sessions.
definitions.D-TOP: The structure top (a failed swing high at the 252-session high) within 40 sessions of the distribution's rally high, when there is one.
definitions.status: Where the last close stands against the mark's own levels. Bottom: HELD (no low under the marked low since), UNDERCUT (a later low went under it and the last close is back at or above it) or BROKEN (the last close is under it). Accumulation: ABOVE (at or above the ACCUM bar's close), BASE (under it, above the low the base stands on) or LOST (under that low). Distribution: BELOW (under the DIST bar's close), RANGE (between it and the rally high) or RECLAIMED (at or above the rally high).
definitions.jump: A row carries jump {date, ratio} when the symbol's bars hold a one-session close-to-close move beyond 3-to-1 either way, inside the last 300 sessions, that no recorded or inferred split explains. It can be a real collapse or a corporate action the record does not carry; percentages on that row should be read with it in mind.
definitions.source: scan = the chart's scan on this engine's bars; harvest = the bottom desk's own date for the symbol (the chart marks it the same way); both = the two agree on the mark inside 5 sessions.
definitions.universe: Listed common stocks (no OTC, preferreds, warrants, units, rights, shells) and ETFs that are not geared or inverse, with a 20-session average dollar volume of at least the floor, a bar in the last 3 sessions and at least 280 sessions of their own continuous history.
